title: fix(metadata): a rewrite of an environment row the boot pass stamped keeps it the environment's, so unregistering the host package keeps it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D6ugbDaCc71TvzfcP9fossQ)_
Fixes #33003

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：#32999 让卸载宿主包时保留环境自己的数据行，但那个保护只挂在启动时登记的那个对象上。之后只要有写入把这一行换成一份仍带宿主印记的拷贝（ObjectQL 的晚到清单桥接及其撤回恢复、对象副本跟随、整包发布/回滚、合并式导入、版本回滚），保护就丢了，印记还被写进数据库，重启后也会被当成宿主的数据删掉。现在这样的拷贝会接过保护（中间先被一份不带印记的内容替换过也一样），而且这一行存进数据库时不带宿主印记，重启后照样认作环境自己的行。
- 为什么改：18.4.0 的发版阻塞项（p0，临时）。#32198 尚未发版，它让卸载宿主包开始按印记删数据；#32999 堵了启动那一半，本 PR 堵改写那一半。没有本 PR，#32198 就要从 18.4.0 撤下。
- 风险与回滚：内存里的条目仍带宿主印记，ObjectQL 记的归属不变；宿主自己的行、用自身 `packageId`/`package` 指名宿主的拷贝、带别的包印记的拷贝、被别的写入方改存为宿主的行，都照旧被卸载。唯一的存储差异是被改写过的环境行在数据库里不再带 `_packageId` 宿主印记（评审已裁定 Clause-② no）。已经被 18.3.0 及更早版本连印记一起存进库的旧行，库里分不出来，仍按宿主自己的行处理，升级路径归 #33043。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`（`writeRegistryEntry` 里新加的一行、`register` 与 `rollback` 写库前去掉印记的几行、`carryEnvironmentRowMark`）；其次 `packages/objectql/src/plugin-late-bridge-environment-row.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 33003`，预期 26 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

PR #32999 (card #32986) keeps an environment row the boot pass stamped with the host when the host package is unregistered, by marking the registry object the pass registered (`storedEnvironmentRows`). Triage's contract review of #32999 (should-fix S1, record 6842932691) found where that stops: a write that replaces the object with a copy still stamped `_packageId: HOST` drops the mark, and `DatabaseLoader.save` stores the stamp in the row's body. The row then reads as the host's own, in this process and after a restart, and `unregisterPackage(HOST)` deletes it.

**Writers measured** (every caller that registers a copy of a stamped item, on #32999's head `a43fc250`):

| writer | call it makes on `MetadataManager` | persists? |
|---|---|---|
| ObjectQL late-manifest bridge, `ownPreviousCopy` arm (`plugin.ts` `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService`) | `register('object', name, merged, { notify: false })`, `merged._packageId` = the owner (HOST) | yes |
| its withdrawal counterpart `restoreExtendedObjectCopies` | `register('object', name, served, { notify: false })`, stamped with the owner | yes |
| ObjectQL object-copy follow (`putObjectCopy`) | `registerInMemory('object', name, body)`, stamped with the owner | no (drops the mark in process) |
| `publishPackage(HOST)` over `collectPackageMembers` | `register(type, name, { ...item.data, publishedDefinition, … })` | yes |
| `revertPackage(HOST)` | `register(type, name, { ...item.data, metadata: publishedDefinition, … })`: the stamp also lands in the envelope's `metadata` body | yes |
| `importMetadata` with `conflictResolution: 'merge'` (not named on the card) | `register(type, name, { ...existing, ...item })` | yes |
| `rollback(type, name, version)` to a version stored with the host stamp (review S2) | `dbLoader.registerRollback(…)`, then `writeRegistryEntry(type, name, restored)`: not through `register` | yes |
| an unstamped replacement (`importMetadata` without `merge`, `bulkRegister`, `rollback` to an authored version), then the object-copy follow stamped with the owner (review S3) | `register(type, name, body)` with no stamp, then `registerInMemory('object', name, { …, _packageId: HOST })` | in process |

The boot bridge (`bridgeObjectsToMetadataService`) skips a name the service already holds, and the protocol's authoring writes register an unstamped body, so neither replaces a marked row with a stamped copy.

**Route: both halves, at the one choke point every writer above goes through.**

- `writeRegistryEntry` (under `register`, `registerInMemory` and `rollback`): a copy that replaces a marked environment row, was not handed out by a loader, and carries the row's host stamp or no stamp joins `storedEnvironmentRows` (`carryEnvironmentRowMark`). The host stamp is remembered per row (`environmentRowHosts`), so a copy stamped with the host after an unstamped replacement is still the row (review S3). A copy stamped with another package is that package's. `isStampedEnvironmentRow` still reads every key at each use, so a copy whose own `packageId` / `package` names the package stays the package's item.
- `register`, and `rollback` before `registerRollback` (review S2): a marked row is stored without the host stamp, at the top and in the publish envelope's `metadata` body (`withoutEnvironmentRowStamp`). The registry entry keeps the stamp, so ObjectQL's owner does not move.

Why not "membership reads something the rewrite keeps" alone: once the stamp is persisted, a rewritten environment row and the host's own row the pass seeded are the same bytes in `sys_metadata` (body `_packageId: HOST`, empty `package_id` column for a non-slotted type), so no rule read at the next boot can tell them apart. The reboot pin needs the stored body to stay package-less, which is the state of a row nothing has rewritten.

### FROM → TO

| # | on a host declaring `HOST`, an environment row (stored package-less) the boot pass stamped, after… | FROM (#32999 head `a43fc250`) | TO |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | the late-manifest bridge re-registers it (`ownPreviousCopy`) | `unregisterPackage(HOST)` deletes it, in process and after a restart | kept, both |
| 2 | `restoreExtendedObjectCopies` | the same | kept, both |
| 3 | the object-copy follow (`registerInMemory`) | deleted in process (nothing persisted) | kept |
| 4 | `publishPackage(HOST)` | deleted, both | kept, both |
| 5 | `publishPackage(HOST)` then `revertPackage(HOST)` | deleted, both | kept, both |
| 6 | `importMetadata` merge | deleted, both | kept, both |
| 7 | `rollback` to a version stored with the host stamp | kept in process, deleted after a restart | kept, both |
| 8 | an unstamped replacement (`importMetadata` overwrite, `bulkRegister`), then the object-copy follow stamped with the host | deleted in process | kept |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: the host's own rows (stored body carrying its stamp) after each of the six writes, in process and after a restart, and after a `rollback`; a copy naming the host by its own `packageId`; a copy stamped with another package (removed by that package's unregister); a stored row another writer re-saved naming the host, read again by the pass over the marked entry; the extender's unregister. Also pinned (review nits N1/N2 of #32999): a `state: 'draft'` row behaves like `active`, and the rule holds for `page` and `report`. The card's `flow` example is stored per `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`), outside this rule, so `page` and `report` stand in for it.

**Clause-②: `no`**, re-derived after measuring. `@objectstack/metadata@18.3.0`'s `unregisterPackage` selected by `packageId` / `package` only, so it never removed an item named by the `_packageId` stamp alone, and these rows were kept there too. This PR removes nothing 18.3.0 kept and keeps nothing 18.3.0 removed. The registry entry keeps its stamp, so every in-process reader answers as before. **Metadata-protocol: `none`**: no authorable key, value or type moves, and no `packages/metadata-protocol` file is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **The one stored difference: `_packageId`.** A rewritten environment row is now stored without `_packageId: HOST` (18.3.0 and `main` stored it with the stamp). Only that key is removed: the pass's other two stamps, `_packageVersion` and `_provenance: 'package'`, stay in the stored body of a rewritten row, so it is not byte-identical to a row nothing rewrote (review N1). No reader moves on them: `applyProtection` fills only unset keys, and the protocol overwrites provenance on read. Triage ruled the open question A on the contract review (6845366666): `Clause-②: no` stands.
- **Rows already stored with the stamp are outside this fix (review S1).** A boot pass of 18.3.0 and earlier registered each loaded item without `skipSourceLoader`, so it stored the stamp in every row it stamped; so did any rewrite before this change. Such a row reads as the host's own (the CONTROLs pin exactly that byte state as removed), and no boot rule can tell it from a row the host seeded. #32986 and this PR protect a fresh database and rows written after the upgrade; the upgrade path is #33043. The changeset says so.
- **A same-named host item over a marked row (review N2).** The carry tests "not loader-handed, and the row's host stamp or none", not "derived from the row". A host item of the same name registered over a marked row by a non-loader path (an artifact reload, a code-declared item) inherits the mark and is kept on unregister. It needs a name collision, where `main` already overwrites the environment's body, and it errs toward keeping.
- **The bridge persists the extender's merged fields into the environment's row.** Pre-existing (#24182 design), unchanged here; the restore puts the owner's body back.
- **Stacked on #32999** at `a43fc250`, the maintainer's word on the seat's decision card (an exception to the no-stacking rule for this p0). `origin/main` merged once after #32999 landed.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts`, `[#33003]` describe (26 cases). The real boot pass (`MetadataPlugin._loadFromFileSystem`) over a `DatabaseLoader` on the file's in-memory driver, host declaring `HOST`, rows of `object` (one `active`, one `draft`), `view`, `app`, `hook`, `dashboard`, `page`, `report`. For each of the six writers in rows 1 to 6, driven through the call it makes on the manager: (1) `unregisterPackage(HOST)` in the same process keeps every rewritten row, registry entry and stored row, the stamp still on the entry; (2) a second boot pass over the same store, then `unregisterPackage(HOST)`, keeps them; (3) CONTROL: the host's own rows (stored body stamped) are removed in both processes. Review follow-ups: `rollback` to a version stored with the host stamp, kept in process and after a reboot (S2), with its CONTROL on the host's own row; an unstamped replacement by `importMetadata` overwrite and by `bulkRegister`, then the object-copy follow stamped with the host, kept (S3). Plus four CONTROLs: a copy naming the host by its own `packageId`; a copy stamped with another package; a stored row another writer re-saved naming the host, read again by the pass over the marked entry; the extender's unregister moves nothing.
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin-late-bridge-environment-row.test.ts` (new, 3 cases): the plugin's own `bridgeManifestObjectsToMetadataService` and `restoreExtendedObjectCopies`, over a real `ObjectQL` registry (the environment object owned by `HOST`, an extender adding `ext_score`), into a real `MetadataManager` primed by the real boot pass over a `DatabaseLoader`; a second pass over the same store is the restart. Bridged: kept in process and after a restart. Restored: kept, both. CONTROL: the host's own object, bridged and restored, is removed. The suite reads `@objectstack/metadata` from `dist/`, so its ablations rebuilt it.

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restore verified: blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

On `metadata-manager.ts` blob `7e2109f16965` (head `012671ee`), the `[#33003]` metadata cases (26):

- A, delete the `carryEnvironmentRowMark` call in `writeRegistryEntry`: 14 failed, 12 passed. Red: every in-process pin (6), the reboot pin of every persisting writer (5), both S3 chains and the S2 rollback pin. Green: the CONTROLs and the `registerInMemory` reboot case (that writer persists nothing).
- B, `loader.save(type, name, data)` in place of the unstamped body: 5 failed, 21 passed. Red: exactly the five reboot pins of the persisting writers.
- C, drop the envelope `metadata` body strip: 1 failed, 25 passed. Red: publish then revert, after a reboot.
- D, drop `this.loadedFrom.has(data)` from the carry: 1 failed, 25 passed. Red: the CONTROL of a stored row another writer re-saved naming the host.
- E, let a copy stamped with another package carry the mark: 1 failed, 25 passed. Red: that CONTROL.
- S3a, carry only a copy stamped exactly like the row (no unstamped carry): 3 failed. Red: both S3 chains and the S2 pin (its rollback follows an unstamped write).
- S3b, do not remember the host stamp: the same 3 failed.
- S2, `registerRollback` given the restored body as is: 1 failed, 25 passed. Red: the rollback pin.

On the objectql pin (3 cases, at `f64ffdce`; the mutated lines are unchanged in purpose), each leg rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata` and the suite was read after it; the restore leg rebuilt again and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` reported the tree clean: carry disabled 2 failed, 1 passed; stamped body saved 2 failed, 1 passed; after restore 3 passed.

</details>
